news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 10% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.77 (vs ₹5.44 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.77. Revenue: ₹113.8m (up 36% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹75.2m (up 30% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 66% (down from 69% in 1H 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.
